news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Shares fell despite an EPS beat as investors weighed continued heavy cash burn against a rich revenue multiple for a company still years from commercial revenue.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.1 million and net loss was $40.6 million, with cash and investments of $1.02 billion (up from $245.8 million at year-end 2025) giving runway into Q3 2028; CEO Howard Robin reiterated 2029 as the target for a first BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Pretrial conference held in Nektar Therapeutics v. Eli Lilly & Co.; jury trial set for September 8, 2026
news.summary: The breach-of-contract suit, in which Nektar accuses former partner Eli Lilly of miscalculating and misrepresenting rezpegaldesleukin trial results, moved toward trial after an earlier postponement, with a jury trial now scheduled for September 8, 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed patients in the first two of three global registrational ZENITH AD trials (ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2) in patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis; initial Phase 3 data are expected mid-2028.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar granted options for 36,000 shares to 23 newly hired employees under its 2025 Inducement Plan, a routine disclosure signaling continued hiring ahead of the Phase 3 program ramp-up.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 10.6% as AbbVie's prospective acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics lifted sentiment across inflammation-and-immunology names, with Canaccord flagging Nektar as a beneficiary.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal atopic dermatitis trial, enrolling patients with prior biologic/JAK-inhibitor experience, expected to begin.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial
catalysts.detail: Court-set jury trial date for Nektar's breach-of-contract suit against Eli Lilly over mishandled rezpegaldesleukin trial data; outcome could affect damages/IP narrative.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 start
catalysts.detail: Company guided to starting a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial Phase 3 readout for rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Company's guided target for filing the first Biologics License Application for rezpegaldesleukin (atopic dermatitis).

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 (TrialNet) data
catalysts.detail: Rezpegaldesleukin Phase 2 study in new-onset stage 3 Type 1 diabetes, initiated with TrialNet in May 2026; readout timing not yet specified.

pulse: Nektar enters the back half of 2026 well-funded ($1.02B cash, runway into Q3 2028) and fully committed to its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, which began dosing in July with a mid-2028 data readout and 2029 BLA target, while a registrational alopecia areata study is slated for early 2027. Sentiment is bullish on Wall Street (Strong Buy consensus, ~$150-153 price targets) and lifted further by sector M&A read-through, but the stock wobbled after Q2 earnings on cash-burn/valuation concerns. The unresolved breach-of-contract jury trial against former partner Eli Lilly, now set for September 8, 2026, remains a background legal overhang unrelated to the core clinical thesis.
